title: Magic Online Theme Decks: card flavor text

entities.name: Mirari
entities.description: A source of power from which the land drank.

entities.name: Olka
entities.description: A witch who studied the evening mist for years and learned to vanish with a thought.

entities.name: Ezoc
entities.description: A Golgari rot farmer.

entities.name: Golgari
entities.description: A guild whose signet represents either a guardian of the natural cycle or one who sold her soul to darkness.

entities.name: Darigaaz
entities.description: One who, like his mother, gave his life defending Dominaria from self-styled gods.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: A plane defended by Darigaaz, home of Yavimaya and Urborg.

entities.name: Xira Arien
entities.description: A regular guest at the Royal Masquerade, envied by the Court, who appears in a new costume every hour.

entities.name: Azorius
entities.description: A guild whose law is strict structure designed to test wills and stall change.

entities.name: Gruul
entities.description: A guild that marks territory with blood, snot, and muck.

entities.name: Rakdos
entities.description: A guild whose signets are made of bone, boiled in blood, and used as murder weapons.

entities.name: Progenitus
entities.description: A hydra-god that elves believe sleeps beneath Naya, feeding on forgotten magics.

entities.name: Naya
entities.description: A land beneath which Progenitus is said to sleep.

entities.name: Selesnya Conclave
entities.description: A guild whose symbol is one of unity, tree supporting sun and sun feeding tree.

entities.name: Simic Combine
entities.description: A guild whose sigil serves as a trademark on biological commodities; its mages back up their experiments.

entities.name: Bant
entities.description: A land whose hearts are as pure as its air.

entities.name: Capashen
entities.description: A family who built the highest towers in Benalia.

entities.name: Benalia
entities.description: A land where the Capashen built towers.

entities.name: Llanowar
entities.description: An elven land with seven elfhames, or kingdoms, each with its own ruler.

entities.name: Jund
entities.description: A cruel world where brutal struggles scar the land and dragons rule the sky.

entities.name: Lucilde Fiksdotter
entities.description: Leader of the Order of the White Shield.

entities.name: Order of the White Shield
entities.description: An order led by Lucilde Fiksdotter that values honor over military might.

entities.name: Alovnek
entities.description: A Boros guildmage who seeks justice now.

entities.name: Boros
entities.description: A guild to which Alovnek belongs.

entities.name: Barrin
entities.description: Author of a progress report about someone's device.

entities.name: Meloku the Clouded Mirror
entities.description: One who advises turning force aside rather than reacting in kind.

entities.name: Naimah
entities.description: A Femeref philosopher.

entities.name: Femeref
entities.description: A people to which Naimah and Daudi belong.

entities.name: Rootwater
entities.description: Depths where salvage and sewage differ only in texture.

entities.name: Gerrard of the Weatherlight
entities.description: A hero associated with the Weatherlight who made an escape covered by a wurm.

entities.name: Weatherlight
entities.description: The vessel Gerrard is named for.

entities.name: Maeveen O'Donagh
entities.description: A soldier and author of Memoirs of a Soldier.

entities.name: Memoirs of a Soldier
entities.description: A memoir written by Maeveen O'Donagh.

entities.name: Crovax
entities.description: One who has witnessed both walking dead and burial alive.

entities.name: Hymn of Angelfire
entities.description: A hymn describing an angel clothed in flames.

entities.name: Yavimaya
entities.description: A forest reminded of past enemies by the time rifts; transplanted by Multani to Urborg's edge.

entities.name: Scroll of Beginnings
entities.description: A writing describing Anger, Brawn, and Genesis.

entities.name: Anger
entities.description: A being that chose a shell of boiling rock for its time as a mortal.

entities.name: Sisay
entities.description: One who comments on the aim of genetic mutants.

entities.name: Keldons
entities.description: A people who divide spoils into trophies and catapult ammunition.

entities.name: Daudi
entities.description: A Femeref tutor.

entities.name: Brawn
entities.description: A being whose arrival made the plane shudder.

entities.name: Mwani
entities.description: A Mtenda herder.

entities.name: Cylian elves
entities.description: Elves who seek visionaries to learn the will of the gargantuan ancients.

entities.name: Krosa
entities.description: A place that grows faster than it burns.

entities.name: Genesis
entities.description: The first being through the Riftstone, which made the world lifeless no more.

entities.name: Riftstone
entities.description: A passage through which Genesis came.

entities.name: Seton
entities.description: A centaur druid.

entities.name: Dosan the Falling Leaf
entities.description: One who says the land grows only where the kami will it.

entities.name: Kami War
entities.description: A war between kami and the mortal world.

entities.name: Reito
entities.description: A town destroyed in one of the first battles of the Kami War.

entities.name: Rath
entities.description: A place that forces plants from its surface.

entities.name: Savra
entities.description: One who speaks of the bones of the past telling their tales.

entities.name: Lord Konda
entities.description: One who speaks of duty and law as the foundation of civilization.

entities.name: Eladamri
entities.description: One waging a war in which the wood elves want no part.

entities.name: Multani
entities.description: One who transplanted Yavimaya to Urborg's edge.

entities.name: Urborg
entities.description: A land to whose edge Yavimaya was transplanted.

entities.name: Cleph
entities.description: A member of the Order of Redeemed Souls.

entities.name: Order of Redeemed Souls
entities.description: An order to which Cleph belongs.

entities.name: Jaya Ballard
entities.description: A task mage with a remedy for water mages.

entities.name: Esper
entities.description: A land where an order seeks to infuse all life with etherium.

entities.name: Mangara of Corondor
entities.description: One freed from amber but still trapped in a place he cannot leave.

entities.name: Song of All
entities.description: A writing promising salvation to those who endure.

events.summary: Olka studies the evening mist for years and learns to vanish with a thought.
events.quote: Once she learned its essence, she could vanish with a thought.

events.summary: Darigaaz gives his life defending Dominaria from self-styled gods.
events.quote: Like his mother before him, Darigaaz gave his life defending Dominaria from the tyranny of self-styled "gods."

events.summary: Brawn arrives and the plane shudders.
events.quote: "'I have arrived,' bellowed Brawn, and the plane shuddered."

events.summary: Genesis is first through the Riftstone, bringing life to the world.
events.quote: "First through the Riftstone was Genesis—and the world was lifeless no more."

events.summary: Reito is destroyed in one of the first battles of the Kami War.
events.quote: Destroyed in one of the first battles of the Kami War, the town of Reito still grieved.

events.summary: A wurm covers Gerrard's escape by eating merfolk.
events.quote: As Gerrard made his escape, the wurm covered his flight by helping itself to three great mouthfuls of merfolk.

events.summary: Multani transplants Yavimaya to Urborg's edge.
events.quote: Multani had transplanted Yavimaya to Urborg's edge.

events.summary: Mangara is freed from the amber but remains imprisoned.
events.quote: I may be free of the amber, but I am still in prison.
